8.3.4.4 EcuM_SelectShutdownCause
[SWS_EcuM_04050] Definition of API function EcuM_SelectShutdownCause
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00023
⌈
Service Name
EcuM_SelectShutdownCause
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EcuM_SelectShutdownCause (
EcuM_ShutdownCauseType target
)
Service ID [hex]
0x1b
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
target
The selected shutdown cause.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The new shutdown cause was set
E_NOT_OK: The new shutdown cause was not set
Description
EcuM_SelectShutdownCause elects the cause for a shutdown. EcuM_SelectShutdownCause
is part of the ECU Manager Module port interface.
Available via
EcuM.h
⌋
